concept.hr: Napon VFO-a padne pri pritisku tipke, pa točke i crte počnu krivom visinom tona
concept.en: When the VFO's supply dips at key-down, every dit and dah starts off pitch

summary.hr: Stvarna snimka CW signala s chirpom i njezina izmjerena visina tona, uz model: skok pri pritisku tipke, povratak i stabilizirani napon.
summary.en: A real recording of a CW signal with chirp and its measured pitch, next to a model: the jump at key-down, the return, and a regulated supply.

what.hr: Aplet applet_chirp_1.html sa snimkom CW signala s chirpom i njezinim prijepisom, te tekst o naponskoj stabilnosti oscilatora (50ohm.de, odjeljak oszillator_spannungsstabilitaet, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The applet applet_chirp_1.html with its recording of a CW signal with chirp and its transcript, and the text on the oscillator's voltage stability (50ohm.de, section oszillator_spannungsstabilitaet, Croatian translation)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu, preveden na engleski, dodani krivulja visine tona izmjerena iz snimke, model odašiljača sa zvukom i predlošci
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit, translated into English, a pitch curve measured from the recording, a model transmitter with sound and presets added
